product_metadata.title: Home Dynamix Premium Rizzy Modern Contemporary Area Rug, Brown, 7'8" Round
features: MODERN DESIGN: The Premium Rizzy rug collection features a modern design in neutral hues. A rich, dark brown center is framed by a border of curved lines in light and dark shades of beige and brown for a look that works well with contemporary decors.
RUG SIZES: 9 x 12 rugs, 8 x 10 rugs, 5 x 7 rugs, 4 x 5 rugs, 2 x 3 rugs, 2 x 7 runner rugs and round area rugs
COZY TEXTURE & RESILIENT CONSTRUCTION: Machine woven from 100% polypropylene yarns with a soft texture that will add a cozy feel over your hardwood floors and provide comfort underfoot.
SUITS ANY ROOM: This collection offers area rugs that are suitable for all indoor spaces. Living room rugs, bedroom rugs, rugs for the entryway, office rugs, dorm rugs, dining room rugs
EASY CARE FOR YOUR RUG: This rug is low maintenance and easy to clean. Shake, spot clean and vacuum your rug as needed to upkeep its beauty.
description: Add a layer of comfort and chic design to your hardwood floors with the Premium Rizzy rug collection from Home Dynamix. Featuring a solid center that's framed with a motif of curved lines in light and dark shades, these rugs are easy to coordinate with your existing modern decor. Made from 100% polypropylene, it offers a soft and cozy texture. Stain and fade resistant, these durable rugs protect floors and hold up well, even in high traffic areas. A jute backing helps keep its shape and beauty.
